abilitySections.title: Organic Ice
content: Iceman's organic ice form grants him full Immunity to all Incinerate, Nova Flame, Bleed, Poison, Coldsnap, and Frostbite effects.

abilitySections.title: Ice Armor
content: Iceman begins the fight with an indefinite Ice Armor Buff, increasing his Armor Rating by +[916.67]. Ice Armor counts as an Armor Up effect.
If Iceman would lose more than 5% of his Max Health from a single source, his Ice Armor protects him from the blow reducing the health loss to 5%, then it is removed.
If Iceman would become Stunned while his Ice Armor is active, the Ice Armor negates the effect, then shatters.
Once removed, Ice Armor takes 15 seconds to reform.
If Ice Armor is removed due to Iceman's abilities, all Frostbite effects expire instantly.

abilitySections.title: Critical Hits - Frostbite
content: 70% chance to inflict a Frostbite Passive. Frostbite Passives last for 10 seconds and deal [8,352.1] Energy Damage when they expire.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: This attack causes all Frostbite Passives to expire instantly and deal an additional [3,930.4] Energy Damage each.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The final hit inflicts a Coldsnap Debuff, dealing [14,739] Energy Damage over 14 seconds.
The final hit inflicts 2 personal Frostbite Passives.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Iceman consumes his Ice Armor to gain +[14,739] Attack Rating for the duration of this attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Coldsnap Debuff, dealing [19,652] Energy Damage over 18 seconds.
This attack instantly reforms Ice Armor.
